title.narrative: Youth Solidarity Against Extremism II – The Next Level

description.narrative: 144 Youth will be divided into 12 core groups participating in the project will be selected according to the following criteria as direct beneficiaries: - Dedicated youth aged between 16 and 25 - Have a minimum of high school education level - Willing to commit to the project - Socially active and are ready to build social networks and connections There will be old beneficiaries from the previous project who will act as buffers between the new beneficiaries who are new to these types of projects, and who might be coming from extremist backgrounds. Beneficiaries include stakeholders such as Municipalities, Mukhtars, Education institutes and their staff, Media outlets, Security Forces, youth from other areas of Lebanon, and the institutions to which they belong. The non-core group youth will be recruited by the core group with the assistance of the project staff. They will be 1,000 youths, where each of the core group will recruit 7 youth. 1000 other youths will be from the other areas of Lebanon who will be included in the activities of the project such as camps, initiatives, conferences, and exchange visits. Indirect beneficiaries of the project will be everyone that the activities of the project have an impact on. These include most of the communities where the project is being implemented in Baalback-Hermel and the residents/youth of other governorates whom connections/bridging will be established with. They are estimated to be more than 100,000 individuals. These are expanding over the Baalback-Hermel governorate and the other governorates, cities, and villages that the youth will be bridging with.
Increase solidarity, coexistence, national belonging, and economic empowerment of youth and citizens of Baalbek-Hermel to prevent violent extremism

Outcome 1: Improved sense of national belonging among the youth and the Baalback-Hermel citizens Output 1.1: Capacitate youth of Baalback-Hermel on national identity and related concepts Output 1.2: Engage youth positively in their communities locally and nationally Output 1.3: Create youth networks from Baalback-Hermel and Lebanon to find common grounds, introduce them to new norms, and build emotional associations Outcome 2: Empowered youth and increased knowledge and application of rule of law in Baalback-Hermel Output 2.1: Build mutual trust between youth and citizens of Baalback-Hermel and security forces, judicial bodies, and educational institutions Output 2.2: Engage Youth in the support of the municipalities and the communities through good governance concepts Outcome 3: Improved the livelihoods of youth and establishment of linkages to the labor market Output 3.1: Capacitate the youth and place them in the labor market through different pathways
